name: Data Pipelines - Provide a utility to migrate your ADF/Synapse pipelines to Fabric Data Factory
description: Customers will be able to point to their pipelines they have created in ADF/Synapse and this utility will perform best-effort methods to recreate the JSON representation of the ADF/Synapse into Fabric Data Factory pipelines
